decisions.title: 118th Street Alignment Study
decisions.description: Establishes a preferred centerline for 118th Street to support future development, right-of-way preservation, roadway connections, drainage, utilities, and coordinated planning among Bernalillo County, Albuquerque, and NMDOT.

decisions.title: 118th Street Amole Mesa to Eucariz Alignment Study
decisions.description: Extends 118th Street planning from Amole Mesa to Eucariz, documenting the recommended alignment, typical roadway section, right-of-way, drainage, utilities, environmental conditions, access, and planning-level costs.

decisions.title: Alameda Drain and Trail Master Plan
decisions.description: Guides improvements along the nine-mile Alameda Drain corridor from I-40 to north Second Street, including trail alignment, crossings, surfacing, accessibility, amenities, landscaping, water quality, operations, and phased implementation.
decisions.large_file_assessment: 36,161,172-byte, 228-page PDF; unusually large because it is an image- and map-rich master plan. No smaller authoritative edition was identified. Optimization could alter the authoritative source, so the original is preserved unchanged.

decisions.title: El Camino Real National Historic Trail Development Concept Plan Executive Summary
decisions.description: Summarizes a proposed multiuse trail along the historic route and San Jose Drain, including alignment, priority projects, heritage sites, amenities, neighborhood loops, crossings, visual identity, and planning-level costs.

decisions.title: Isleta Drain and Trail Master Plan
decisions.description: Preserves Bernalillo County's adopted plan for a South Valley community trail along the Isleta Drain, documenting public priorities, trail alignment, crossings, connections, amenities, environmental conditions, design concepts, and implementation.

decisions.title: Atrisco Vista Boulevard Alignment Study
decisions.description: Evaluates the future Atrisco Vista Boulevard corridor north of Double Eagle Road, addressing alignment, roadway sections, traffic, access, drainage, utilities, environmental resources, trails, right-of-way, project impacts, and preliminary costs.

decisions.title: Bernalillo County Pedestrian–Bicyclist Safety Action Plan
decisions.description: Updates the County's pedestrian and bicyclist safety strategy using public engagement, equity and transportation-insecurity measures, facility inventories, crash analysis, a high-fatal-and-injury network, policy recommendations, countermeasures, and ranked priority projects.

decisions.title: Bernalillo County Pedestrian–Bicyclist Safety Action Plan Appendix
decisions.description: Provides the safety plan's supporting inventories, engagement records, crash and equity analysis, evaluation methodology, community-area findings, detailed priority-project tables, maps, and technical documentation.

decisions.title: Sunport Commerce Center Transportation Plan
decisions.description: Establishes the adopted roadway, freight, transit, bicycle, pedestrian, access, right-of-way, and capital-improvement framework for the 800-acre industrial district between Second Street, I-25, Woodward Road, and Rio Bravo Boulevard.

decisions.title: Near South Valley Multimodal Study
decisions.description: Identifies gaps and priorities across the Near South Valley street, sidewalk, bicycle, trail, transit, passenger-rail, and freight networks, emphasizing accessible sidewalks, bikeway connections, safer crossings, and coordinated multimodal projects.
